headline: Audi's Tsunoda appeal will be heard on 25 November
body: The FIA International Court of Appeal will hear Audi's case over the Italian Grand Prix stewards' decision at the FIA's Paris headquarters. Audi argues Yuki Tsunoda caused the extra formation lap after the red flag and should have started from the pit lane or taken a stop-and-go penalty; the stewards took no further action. Tsunoda finished seven seconds ahead of Gabriel Bortoleto, who could gain a point if a penalty is applied.
